_readme: Expected shape of the app. preflight.py compares against this instead of hardcoding numbers, so a real change (adding cards, adding a topic) is a deliberate edit here in the same commit, not a silent drift. If preflight reports a count mismatch and the change was intentional, update the number here and say so in the commit message.
_must_contain_readme: Features that must never silently vanish from the template. Each value is a literal string preflight looks for in the decoded template. Add an entry whenever something is shipped that would be quietly catastrophic to lose.
